title: Daily digest: Hyderabad Metro Rail Completes Nine Year | Jaish Terrorist Wanted To 'Achieve Marty | Cyberabad to launch contra-flow BRTS ser | Floor Cleaning With Drinking Water Emerg | Election Commission revised SSR timeline
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / NDTV / Times of India
bullets_en: Hyderabad Metro Rail Completes Nine Years, Records 942 million Passenger Journeys.
Jaish Terrorist Wanted To 'Achieve Martyrdom', Was Trained On WhatsApp.
Cyberabad to launch contra-flow BRTS service between JNTU and Raidurg within a week.
Floor Cleaning With Drinking Water Emerges as Major Cause of Water Wastage in Hyderabad.
Election Commission revised SSR timeline for Bengal; clarifies on SIR appeals.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad Metro Rail ne nau saal mukammal kiye, 942 million musafir safar record kiye
Jaish ka dehshatgard 'shahadat' chahta tha, usay WhatsApp par training mili thi.
Cyberabad ek hafte ke andar JNTU aur Raidurg ke darmiyan contra-flow BRTS shuru karega.
Peenay ke pani se farsh ki safai Hyderabad mein pani ke ziyan ki bari waja ban gayi.
Election Commission ne Bengal ke liye SSR timeline revise kar di, SIR appeals par wazahat.
